lead_time_read.verdict: NO tradable lead-time. Zero day-0 response; 36% of CAAR is pre-event drift; [0,20] significance is benchmark-composition artifact (vanishes vs SPY, reproduced by random-date placebo).

known_biases.collector_truncation: pageSize=100, no pagination, sort=LastUpdatePostDate:desc (collectors/clinicaltrials.py:78-82). 7/19 tickers at >=100 NCTs. Pre-2019 events are look-ahead-selected on trial continuation. Events by year 2004-2012=32 vs 2019-2026=994.
known_biases.cluster_count: 19 sponsor tickers = at most 19 independent clusters, all mega-cap pharma, heavily time-overlapping.
known_biases.overlap: Event windows overlap within ticker; naive iid t is invalid and is reported only to show inflation (e.g. +2.90 vs cluster +2.30 vs calendar-time +0.86).

halt_channel.reason: No halt-onset date. is_halt is CURRENT overallStatus at pull time; last_update is the last update of any kind (median 1608d after first_post). Already excluded in scripts/backtest_event_priors.py:411-427 (M5).
